feed.subtitle: The Verge is about technology and how it makes us feel. Founded in 2011, we offer our audience everything from breaking news to reviews to award-winning features and investigations, on our site, in video, and in podcasts.

entry.title: Uber and Zipline’s drone delivery service takes flight in Houston
entry.summary: Uber Eats is officially launching drone delivery in partnership with Zipline starting Tuesday. The initial rollout begins in the Houston suburb of Spring, Texas, with Dallas next in line and dozens of additional US cities planned. entry.title: Hacker behind 2022 GTA VI leaks pleads guilty
entry.summary: Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group who leaked 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022 and hacked other big companies, pleaded guilty on Monday, according to the UK's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS).
